raw_posts.name: UseIt Studio
raw_posts.tagline: Your AI design agent for real, editable project files.
raw_posts.description: UseIt is an AI design studio for things you can hold. Describe what you want in one sentence. UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.

raw_posts.name: BAND for Developers
raw_posts.description: Running multiple coding agents shouldn’t mean becoming their project manager. BAND lets them work together. Connect agents across your existing development tools and give them a shared workspace to coordinate tasks, exchange context, and hand off work without you playing middleman. See what every agent is doing, step in when decisions need your judgment, and scale agentic development across teams. Your agents stay in their existing tools while BAND handles the teamwork.

raw_posts.name: Needle
raw_posts.description: Find your perfect leads and reach out by prompting Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok. Wherever your ICP are, on LinkedIn, Instagram, or email.

raw_posts.name: The Library
raw_posts.tagline: Your business context organized by queries
raw_posts.description: The Querri Library is where your data gets organized around the questions your business asks, so every answer comes from the same trusted, shared foundation.. The library learns your definitions, business context, and past analysis, so its answers are grounded in how your business actually works. And when it doesn’t know, it says so, instead of making things up.

raw_posts.name: TwinMind for Desktop
raw_posts.tagline: Transcribe meetings and dictate anywhere on Mac & Windows
raw_posts.description: TwinMind now lives natively on your Desktop! Auto-detect meetings in Zoom, Meet, Teams and more, and get live transcripts and summaries in 140+ languages. With calendar reminders, join the call in one click and start capturing. A floating mic stays with you across every app and space: hold the hotkey to dictate, and a cleaned-up text pastes straight wherever you're writing.

raw_posts.name: SuperCMO AI
raw_posts.tagline: Open-source skills that turn your Claude into an AI CMO
raw_posts.description: Open-source agent skills that turn Claude Code, Cursor or Codex into an AI CMO. Give your agent your website and it learns your brand. It studies your competitors' ads, ranks what you should test next, writes the copy for each platform, and makes the ads (UGC videos, product ads, cartoon ads, image ads, product photos and more). It checks in with you at every step, and nothing expensive renders until you approve. Bring your own model keys, or pay per use with ours. Apache-2.0.

raw_posts.name: Notion Auto
raw_posts.tagline: Notion’s rebuilt Agents run for hours and cost far less
raw_posts.description: Notion’s Agents update rebuilds the agent harness so tasks can run for 24 hours or more, with a computer, a browser and a Review for me safety mode. Auto now routes each task to the best model, and Notion says it matches Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower cost. You can connect a ChatGPT plan, Notion MCP is overhauled, and a new credit system covers all AI usage. Live now for new customers.

raw_posts.name: NativeShip
raw_posts.tagline: The easy way to launch your n8n native integration
raw_posts.description: NativeShip helps SaaS teams launch and maintain an n8n integration from their existing API. Nodes follow n8n's official guidelines and are ready for verification, with standard publishing and maintenance built in. Shape the node with a live preview, publish from your own GitHub and npm in one click, and track every release. No technical skills needed.

raw_posts.name: The Brains
raw_posts.tagline: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited
raw_posts.description: The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

raw_posts.name: Flagsmith Experiments
raw_posts.tagline: Open-source A/B testing built on your feature flags
raw_posts.description: Flagsmith now runs A/B tests on the flags you already use. Pick a flag and a metric, and get a Bayesian read on which variant wins. Use our managed warehouse or bring your own ClickHouse or Databricks. Free and open source, self-hosted or cloud.
